item.create.goggles.tooltip.behaviour1: Kinetic components show actual _speed_, _inertia_, _torque_ and _structural strength_. Hold _Sneak_ for kinetic and elastic energy and power. _Load Gauges_ show physical network load and instrument status.
item.create.copper_backtank.tooltip.beha: Charges from _actual shaft travel_ in either direction: _128 RPM_ adds _one air unit per tick_. Fractional progress survives pickup and wearing; _full_ or _waterlogged_ tanks release working load.
item.create.netherite_backtank.tooltip.b: Charges from _actual shaft travel_ in either direction: _128 RPM_ adds _one air unit per tick_. Fractional progress survives pickup and wearing; _full_ or _waterlogged_ tanks release working load.
block.create.flywheel.tooltip.summary: Stores _kinetic energy_ in its rotor. More inertia smooths changing loads and lets a disconnected drive _coast_.
block.create.flywheel.tooltip.behaviour1: Accelerates gradually. Stored energy can keep connected machines working after the source is disconnected.
block.create.shaft.tooltip.summary: Transmits _torque_ through an elastic connection. Shocks or excess torque can _break_ it.
block.create.cogwheel.tooltip.summary: Changes transmission direction; mesh with a large cog to change _ratio_. Higher speed trades away available torque.
block.create.large_cogwheel.tooltip.summ: Changes shaft axis or _ratio_. Loads and inertia are transmitted through the gear train.
block.create.gearbox.tooltip.summary: Relays _torque_ between perpendicular axes. Connected loads still accelerate over time.
block.create.clutch.tooltip.summary: _0_ redstone engages, _15_ releases, and _1–14_ reduces transmitted torque. It may _slip_ under load; the released output can coast.
block.create.gearshift.tooltip.summary: Redstone reverses the transmission _ratio_. The driven inertia must brake before reversing.
block.create.rotation_speed_controller.t: Sets the _controller shaft / upper large cogwheel_ speed ratio. _1×_ is centred; negative reverses, _0×_ disconnects. _Ctrl + right-click_ gives precise 1/16 steps.
block.create.sequenced_gearshift.tooltip: Executes output _angle_, _distance_ and _wait_ instructions. Brakes ahead of targets under load, then holds position.
block.create.water_wheel.tooltip.summary: Water currents provide _torque_. Actual speed rises gradually and falls with load.
block.create.large_water_wheel.tooltip.s: Provides more _torque_ at a lower no-load speed than a small water wheel. Connected inertia and load determine actual motion.
block.create.windmill_bearing.tooltip.su: Right-click to assemble a windmill. Sails set available _wind torque_; the entire structure adds _inertia_ and _air drag_.
block.create.creative_motor.tooltip.summ: The panel sets a _drive target_. Connected inertia accelerates gradually. The motor body has _unlimited structural strength_.
block.create.hand_crank.tooltip.summary: Hold right-click to apply manual _torque_; sneak to reverse. Heavy loads resist starting and reversing.
block.create.copper_valve_handle.tooltip: Sets a commanded rotation _angle_. Actual movement still depends on the torque needed by the load.
block.create.mechanical_pump.tooltip.sum: Actual _rotation direction_ and the _arrow_ determine active pressure rise. Pipe head, inventory and air outlets set flow; liquid can _back-drive_ the shaft.
block.create.fluid_pipe.tooltip.summary: Contains an ordered inventory of _air and fluids_. Gravity and pumps move it through connected pipes; trapped air needs an _outlet_.
block.create.smart_fluid_pipe.tooltip.su: Filters _real fluids_ while letting _air_ through. Filter rejection does not delete pipe inventory.
block.create.fluid_valve.tooltip.summary: Rotation opens or closes the valve. A _closed_ valve blocks _all media_, including virtual air.
block.create.fluid_tank.tooltip.summary: Ports use the tank’s _actual liquid level_. A port above the surface can accept liquid or supply air, but cannot drain liquid below it.
block.create.hose_pulley.tooltip.summary: Draws or deposits fluid at its _lowered endpoint_. Its height, surrounding medium and the connected pressure network determine flow.
block.create.speedometer.tooltip.summary: Measures _actual shaft speed_. Hold a _Wrench_ and hold right-click on the dial to set a fixed range of _64–1048576 RPM_. The range does not cap the shaft.
block.create.stressometer.tooltip.summar: Displays physical _load factor_. _100%%_ is the dial centre; _infinity_ is the end. Unavailable readings park in the hatched zone. Comparator: _100%% → 8_, _infinity → 15_, _parked → 0_.
block.create.encased_fan.tooltip.summary: Higher _actual speed_ increases processing speed with diminishing returns. Resistance grows _quadratically_ with speed; the right processing medium is still required.
_Empty-hand right-click_ assembles or disassembles the structure. Its output starts from rest; structure _inertia_ and _air drag_ affect motion.
block.create.mechanical_piston.tooltip.s: Moves its structure using actual shaft travel. Attached mass adds _inertia_ and _air drag_; working tools consume additional energy.
block.create.rope_pulley.tooltip.summary: Moves attached structures vertically. _Inertia_, _air drag_ and working tool loads affect acceleration and speed.
block.create.gantry_carriage.tooltip.sum: Moves along Gantry Shafts. Mounted mass and working tools react back onto the _drive_.
block.create.clockwork_bearing.tooltip.s: Follows the time of day through its drive. Attached blocks still add _inertia_ and _air resistance_.
block.create.weighted_ejector.tooltip.su: Winds using _actual shaft travel_. Once charged it unloads and can launch _without power_; each launch spends the round of charge.
block.create.crushing_wheel.tooltip.summ: Two wheels use _relative shaft travel_ and shared feed. Unequal speeds or one stopped wheel can work; same-direction equal speeds cannot. Both wheels receive reaction torque.
block.create.steam_engine.tooltip.summar: Shares actual boiler supply. Low-speed output is _torque-limited_, high-speed output _power-limited_; the no-load governor approaches _512 RPM_. Also right-click a _bogey_ to install a train drive.
block.create.train_controls.tooltip.summ: Default _W_ drives, _S_ brakes, _X/Z_ shift through _R, N, 1–5_. _Space_ assists station approach and parking. Steam-powered bogeys need real water, heat and fuel.
block.create.track_station.tooltip.summa: Assembles steam-equipped trains and serves as a scheduled stop. Approaching trains need _finite braking distance_ and a working steam supply to depart.
block.create.cart_assembler.tooltip.summ: Mounts structures onto minecarts. Assembled mass and air resistance affect _acceleration_, _coasting_ and _braking_.
block.create.chain_conveyor.tooltip.summ: Relays rotation and carries packages. Parcel travel follows _actual signed shaft speed_, including fast turns and reversals.
block.create.mechanical_press.tooltip.su: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.millstone.tooltip.summary: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.mechanical_mixer.tooltip.su: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.mechanical_saw.tooltip.summ: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.mechanical_drill.tooltip.su: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.deployer.tooltip.summary: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
block.create.mechanical_arm.tooltip.summ: Processes with _actual shaft travel_. Working draws torque; idle releases working load. _Stopping retains progress_, and stored kinetic energy can keep it moving.
Applies _finite braking_ at overlap and transfers only after stopping. Wrench settings select _occupancy/phase feedback_ and _idle/redstone release_. Depart after full retraction.
block.create.portable_fluid_interface.to: Applies _finite braking_ at overlap and transfers only after stopping. Wrench settings select _occupancy/phase feedback_ and _idle/redstone release_. Depart after full retraction.
block.create.controller_rail.tooltip.sum: A _one-way_ variable-speed rail controlled by redstone strength. Its _finite force_ requires longer braking zones for heavy contraptions.
block.create.sticky_mechanical_piston.to: Moves its structure using actual shaft travel. Attached mass adds _inertia_ and _air drag_; working tools consume additional energy.
block.create.gantry_shaft.tooltip.summar: Moves along Gantry Shafts. Mounted mass and working tools react back onto the _drive_.
block.create.andesite_encased_shaft.tool: Transmits _torque_ through an elastic connection. Shocks or excess torque can _break_ it.
block.create.brass_encased_shaft.tooltip: Transmits _torque_ through an elastic connection. Shocks or excess torque can _break_ it.
block.create.andesite_encased_cogwheel.t: Changes transmission direction; mesh with a large cog to change _ratio_. Higher speed trades away available torque.
block.create.brass_encased_cogwheel.tool: Changes transmission direction; mesh with a large cog to change _ratio_. Higher speed trades away available torque.
block.create.andesite_encased_large_cogw: Changes shaft axis or _ratio_. Loads and inertia are transmitted through the gear train.
block.create.brass_encased_large_cogwhee: Changes shaft axis or _ratio_. Loads and inertia are transmitted through the gear train.
block.differentialcreate.brass_clutch.to: A clutch with _adjustable engagement_. Redstone releases it; with an _empty hand_, hold right-click on the side knob to set _0–100%% engagement_. Heavy loads can cause _slip_.
block.differentialcreate.gear_lever.tool: Selects train gears _R, N, 1–5_. Right-click to shift up; sneak-right-click to shift down. Default keyboard controls are _X/Z_.
item.differentialcreate.composite_fricti: A friction material for the _Brass Clutch_. Basin-press an iron sheet, leather, powdered obsidian and a slimeball; _no heat_ is needed.
item.differentialcreate.steam_hose.toolt: Connects a _boiler_ directly to a _powered bogey_. Select the two endpoints in either order, in the same dimension and within _48 blocks_.
item.differentialcreate.condenser_pipe.t: Install on a _steam-upgraded bogey_, one per bogey. Recovers _90%%_ of steam water, reducing that engine’s net water use to _10%%_.
Right-click to assemble or disassemble; cutting power alone does not disassemble.
item.create.schedule.tooltip.summary: Lets a _conductor_ drive a steam-equipped train. Conductors select gears automatically; _water, heat and fuel_ are still required for departures.
block.create.railway_casing.tooltip.summ: Creates a _bogey_ when used on train tracks. Before assembly, right-click that bogey with a _Steam Engine_ and connect its steam supply.
block.create.mechanical_harvester.toolti: A moving tool draws _work_ from actual feed motion while contacting material. Its reaction can slow or stop a heavy contraption.
block.create.mechanical_plough.tooltip.s: A moving tool draws _work_ from actual feed motion while contacting material. Its reaction can slow or stop a heavy contraption.
block.create.mechanical_roller.tooltip.s: A moving tool draws _work_ from actual feed motion while contacting material. Its reaction can slow or stop a heavy contraption.
block.create.encased_chain_drive.tooltip: Relays rotation through an _elastic transmission_. Loads and inertia reflect through the selected ratio; excessive torque can break a component.
Relays rotation through an _elastic transmission_. Loads and inertia reflect through the selected ratio; excessive torque can break a component.
item.create.belt_connector.tooltip.summa: Connects shafts with an _elastic belt transmission_. Connected loads determine actual speed; stored energy can keep the belt moving after drive release.
item.create.vertical_gearbox.tooltip.sum: Relays _torque_ between vertical and horizontal axes. Connected inertia and load act through the transmission.
differentialcreate.ponder.dynamics.heade: How Torque, Inertia, and Flywheels Work
differentialcreate.ponder.dynamics.text_: Limited torque and shaft inertia make speed change gradually.
Flywheels store energy and can keep machines working after power is cut.
Gearing up trades torque for speed; gearing down increases torque.
Connections flex; torque exceeding a component's strength breaks it.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.header: Clutches, Slip, and the Brass Clutch
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_1: Full engagement limits: standard 1024, Brass 32768 su/RPM.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_2: Redstone 0 fully engages, 15 disengages; intermediate signals reduce torque capacity.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_3: Disengaging the clutch lets the output coast on its inertia.
differentialcreate.ponder.clutch.text_4: With empty hands, hold right-click on Brass panels; redstone reduces engagement.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.header: Adjusting Gear Ratios with the Ratio Controller
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_1: Set the lower shaft/top cog speed ratio, from -16 to +16.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_2: Negative ratios reverse; zero disconnects. The dial uses nonlinear spacing.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_3: Top cog input at +2 ratio doubles shaft speed and halves torque.
differentialcreate.ponder.ratio.text_4: Ctrl + right-click opens numeric input, rounded to sixteenths.
differentialcreate.ponder.load_gauge.hea: Reading Power Demand with the Load Gauge
differentialcreate.ponder.load_gauge.tex: Load compares sustained power demand with available drive power, excluding stored inertia.
Midscale means 100%% load and signal 8; infinite overload gives 15.
Without active power, coasting gives no load reading and signal zero.
Goggles show details; a stationary network uses the starting torque budget.
differentialcreate.ponder.speed_gauge.he: Measuring Shaft Speed and Adjusting Dial Range
differentialcreate.ponder.speed_gauge.te: The Speedometer measures actual speed at its own shaft.
Hold right-click on the dial with a Wrench to change its range.
Range changes the dial and comparator; Goggles still show actual RPM.
differentialcreate.ponder.pump_direction: Pump Direction, Shaft Rotation, and Fluid Inertia
Counterclockwise from East/Up/South pressurizes along the pump arrow.
Reverse rotation reverses pressure; liquid inertia delays the flow reversal.
A Wrench flips the arrow; reversing both arrow and rotation cancels out.
Gravity can backdrive pumps; zero flow consumes no sustained pumping power.
differentialcreate.ponder.pump_network.h: Pipe Pressure Networks and Air Venting
differentialcreate.ponder.pump_network.t: Loaded connected pipes share pressure calculations, without a fixed 16-block range.
New pipes need air outlets; closed Valves block both air and liquid.
Smart Pipes filter liquids while allowing air through.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_1: Glue the structure; empty-hand right-click assembles it. Repeat to disassemble.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_2: Structures start from rest; mass adds inertia and exposed surfaces add drag.
differentialcreate.ponder.bearing.text_3: Cutting power keeps the structure assembled and coasting.
differentialcreate.ponder.structure_load: Moving Structures and Contraption Tool Loads
Moving structures accelerate under finite force against their inertia and air drag.
Mounted tools consume drive energy when cutting, harvesting, ploughing, or rolling.
Moving Deployers consume energy per action and wait when energy is insufficient.
differentialcreate.ponder.continuous_wor: Machine Progress and Coasting Through Work
Processing advances with shaft travel; idle machines release their processing load.
Slow rotation still advances work; stopping preserves the current operation's progress.
After power is cut, sufficient flywheel energy can finish an active operation.
differentialcreate.ponder.backtank.text_: Backtanks charge in either direction: one air unit per tick at 128 RPM.
Fractional charging progress survives breaking, pickup, and wearing the backtank.
Full or waterlogged backtanks stop charging and release load, while retaining inertia.
differentialcreate.ponder.ejector_work.t: Ejectors wind with shaft travel; farther targets require more work.
Fully wound ejectors fire without power; each launch consumes the full charge.
Farther targets need extra winding; closer targets discard excess. Airborne trajectories persist.
differentialcreate.ponder.crusher_work.h: Crushing Wheel Relative Motion and Batch Work
differentialcreate.ponder.crusher_work.t: Crushing uses relative wheel motion and applies reaction torque to both wheels.
Unequal same-direction speeds also crush when feeding inward; equal speeds cannot.
A 64-item batch requires six times the work and finishes together.
differentialcreate.ponder.steam_power.he: Boiler Steam Supply and Engine Governor
differentialcreate.ponder.steam_power.te: Heat, boiler size, and actual water supply constrain available steam.
Low speed is torque-limited; high speed is power-limited. Engines share steam.
Near 512 RPM the governor throttles steam; cutting steam allows coasting.
differentialcreate.ponder.train_power.he: Powering Trains with Steam Engines, Hoses, and Condensers
differentialcreate.ponder.train_power.te: Before assembly, install power by using a Steam Engine on a bogey.
Use a Steam Hose between boiler and powered bogey, within 48 blocks.
Fit a Condenser Pipe to recover 90%% of exhaust water.
Separate tanks supply water; chests/barrels supply fuel. Vaults are excluded.
Driving Steam Trains, Shifting Gears, and Station Parking
Drive: W throttles; S brakes. Install a Gear Lever for X/Z shifting.
Neutral disconnects wheels; W still revs the engine and consumes water.
Hold Space for station approach/parking; W releases. Brake early to avoid overruns.
Scheduled conductors drive automatically; a Gear Lever enables automatic shifting.
differentialcreate.ponder.portable_docki: Portable Interface Braking, Docking, and Wrench Settings
Face interfaces 1–2 blocks apart; transfer requires stopping. Excess speed overshoots.
Successful transfers refresh the idle timer; retracting finishes before movement resumes.
Use a Wrench: select release mode and mechanical occupancy feedback.
differentialcreate.ponder.minecart_dynam: Minecart Contraption Mass, Rail Forces, and Couplings
Mounting a structure adds inertia and air drag to its minecart.
Rail propulsion and braking are finite; heavier carts accelerate and stop slower.
Couplings transmit force between carts; mounted tools also consume their kinetic energy.
differentialcreate.ponder.sequencer.head: Precise Travel Control with Sequenced Gearshifts
differentialcreate.ponder.sequencer.text: Sequenced Gearshifts measure actual output travel for angle and distance commands.
It brakes ahead based on inertia and load, then holds the target.
Same-direction steps flow; reversals stop first. Completed sequences need another redstone pulse.
differentialcreate.ponder.fan_work.heade: Encased Fan Speed, Processing Rate, and Drag
differentialcreate.ponder.fan_work.text_: Water washes; fire smokes; lava blasts; soul fire haunts.
Processing matches baseline at 64 RPM; faster rotation approaches fourfold throughput.
Spinning fans continuously experience air drag; resisting torque grows with RPM squared.
create.ponder.stressometer.header: Monitoring Network Load with the Load Gauge
create.ponder.stressometer.text_1: Load compares sustained power demand with available drive power, excluding stored inertia.
create.ponder.stressometer.text_2: Goggles show details; a stationary network uses the starting torque budget.
create.ponder.stressometer.text_3: Midscale means 100%% load and signal 8; infinite overload gives 15.
create.ponder.clutch.text_2: Redstone 0 fully engages, 15 disengages; intermediate signals reduce torque capacity.
create.ponder.gearshift.text_2: Redstone reverses drive; shafts reverse gradually.
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_3: Half a regular wheel's unloaded speed, with greater inertia...
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_1: Water currents provide finite torque, gradually accelerating the wheel.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_5: More sails add drive power and inertia.
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_2: Set rated RPM here; unloaded speed approaches twice that.
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_7: Faster fans extend airflow and accelerate processing; air drag grows with RPM squared.
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_flow.text_: Counterclockwise from East/Up/South pressurizes along the pump arrow.
Counterclockwise from East/Up/South pressurizes along the pump arrow.
Reverse rotation reverses pressure; liquid inertia delays the flow reversal.
A Wrench flips the arrow; reversing both arrow and rotation cancels out.
create.ponder.mechanical_pump_speed.text: Loaded connected pipes share pressure calculations, without a fixed 16-block range.
Spinning the pump faster builds stronger pressure to push the fluid...
Gravity can backdrive pumps; zero flow consumes no sustained pumping power.
Multiple pumps in a shared pipe network combine their pressure according to each pump's arrow and shaft rotation direction
Make sure their effective pumping directions—set by both arrow orientation and shaft rotation—all push the same way
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_4: Pressure and gravity drive fluids; incoming liquid must displace air.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_5: New pipes must vent their air.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_6: As air escapes, liquid flows through the pipes to the receiving container.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_7: Tank ports above the liquid surface cannot draw liquid.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_1: Smart Pipes filter liquids, but pass air.
Set the lower shaft/top cog speed ratio, from -16 to +16.
Ctrl + right-click opens numeric input, rounded to sixteenths.
create.ponder.mechanical_bearing.text_2: Glue the structure; empty-hand right-click assembles it. Repeat to disassemble.
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_1: Cutting power keeps the structure assembled and coasting.
create.ponder.bearing_modes.text_2: Glue the structure; empty-hand right-click assembles it. Repeat to disassemble.
create.ponder.sequenced_gearshift.text_1: Sequenced Gearshifts measure actual output travel for angle and distance commands.
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_2: Crushing needs relative wheel motion feeding into the gap.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_6: Wind by rotation; charged ejectors fire unpowered.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_11: Step onto a charged Ejector to launch, consuming its full charge.
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_4: Engines have torque and steam power limits.
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_8: Heat, size, and water constrain steam; inspect boiler status with Goggles.
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_9: Engines share boiler steam; adding engines cannot exceed the available steam power.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_8: Boilers draw onboard water from separate tanks and fuel from chests/barrels.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_9: Vault cargo is excluded from automatic refuelling.
create.ponder.train_controls.text_3: Drive: W throttles; S brakes. Install a Gear Lever for X/Z shifting.

create.ponder.train_controls.text_5: Hold Space for station approach/parking; W releases. Brake early to avoid overruns.
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_4: Eligible seated mobs or Blaze Burners in front of Controls can conduct.
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Powered and Controller Rails apply finite propulsion and braking; heavier carts respond slower.
create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: Face interfaces 1–2 blocks apart; transfer requires stopping. Excess speed overshoots.
Face interfaces 1–2 blocks apart; transfer requires stopping. Excess speed overshoots.
Successful transfers refresh the idle timer; retracting finishes before movement resumes.
create.ponder.portable_fluid_interface.t: Face interfaces 1–2 blocks apart; transfer requires stopping. Excess speed overshoots.
Face interfaces 1–2 blocks apart; transfer requires stopping. Excess speed overshoots.

create.ponder.portable_storage_interface: Redstone prevents docking or releases it. Use a Wrench to set comparator output and release mode.
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_2: Finite torque drives the hands toward daytime angles, against inertia and drag.
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_2: Active cycles need shaft travel; stopping preserves their progress.
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: Active transfers need shaft travel; stopping preserves their progress.
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_2: Powering trains still consumes resources in unloaded chunks.

create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_2: Power the driving Gearshift: other shafts double speed and halve torque.
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_3: Power a driven Gearshift: its shaft halves speed and doubles torque.
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_4: Ordinary Chain Drives have twice the powered Gearshift's speed ratio, with inverse torque.
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_1: Valve Handles apply finite torque toward a set angle.
create.ponder.valve_handle.text_5: Stopped Bearings stay assembled; empty-hand right-click disassembles them.
create.ponder.belt_connector.text_1: Use a belt item on two shafts to connect them.
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_4: Air passing through fire smokes food.
create.ponder.fan_processing.text_8: Fans also process items on Depots and Belts.
create.ponder.creative_motor.text_1: Creative Motors provide adjustable, finite torque.
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_2: More water-covered sides add no power.
create.ponder.water_wheel.text_3: Use planks to change its appearance.
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_1: Large Water Wheels draw power from adjacent water currents.
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_2: More water-covered sides add no power.
create.ponder.large_water_wheel.text_5: Use planks to change its appearance.
create.ponder.chain_gearshift.text_1: Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave like ordinary Chain Drives.
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_1: A pair of Crushing Wheels grinds items.
create.ponder.crushing_wheels.text_3: Insert items from above for processing.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_1: Hold an Ejector; sneak-right-click to select its target.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_2: Once placed, it launches objects toward that target.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_3: Target height and distance must remain within range.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_4: Targets cannot be off to either side.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_5: Without a valid target, it aims one block ahead.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_7: Once charged, items trigger a launch.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_8: It waits for space in the target inventory.
create.ponder.weighted_ejector.text_10: It launches only when the held stack reaches the selected amount.
create.ponder.mechanical_arm_redstone.te: A brief redstone interruption triggers one working cycle.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_1: Windmill Bearings attach to the block directly ahead.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_2: Join the structure with Super Glue.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_3: Include enough sails or wool to form a windmill.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_4: Right-click activates the windmill's power output.
create.ponder.windmill_source.text_7: Empty-hand right-click disassembles the windmill for editing.
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_5: Right-click assembles or disassembles the clock hands.
create.ponder.clockwork_bearing.text_7: Keep the two hands separate: do not glue them together.
create.ponder.cart_assembler_rails.text_: Assemblers on regular rails do not actively brake passing carts.
Other minecart types also carry structures.
Furnace Carts take coal/charcoal from eligible storage, excluding Vaults.
create.ponder.deployer_redstone.text_3: A brief redstone interruption triggers one working cycle.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_1: Pipes connect multiple fluid sources and targets.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_2: Use a Wrench to add windows to straight pipes.
create.ponder.fluid_pipe_flow.text_3: Windowed pipes do not form side connections.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_2: At a source, the filter selects which liquid to extract.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_3: Use a fluid container on the filter slot.
create.ponder.smart_pipe.text_4: In pipelines, only matching liquids pass; air remains unfiltered.
create.ponder.track_chunks.text_1: Tracks remain functional outside loaded chunks.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_3: Open the Station interface and enter Assembly Mode.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_4: Scheduled trains cannot approach during assembly.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_6: Click again to cycle bogey designs.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_11: Add opposite-facing Controls to depart stations in both directions.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_14: Use a map on the Station for a named marker.
create.ponder.train_assembly.text_15: Use a Wrench to relocate trains onto nearby tracks.
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_3: Give the completed Schedule to a conductor.
create.ponder.train_schedule.text_5: Lead a creature and use its Seat to mount it.
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_1: Place Steam Engines on Fluid Tanks.
create.ponder.steam_engine.text_5: The smallest boiler needs four tank blocks.
